items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: The only one that could help or answer that question would be Chink. He remembers Bakay and all those and could give you their first name more than I could

ctx.x: Only way... I'll tell you. The only one that could help or answer that question would be Chink. He remembers Bakay and all those and could give you their first name more than I could, because he's been down in New Orleans more or less ever since. He left just for a short time up in Chicago and come right on back. So he remembered those names far more than I could.
Now another fellow... Did you ever know a fellow named Bro that played bass?
